scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/free-ports.ps1 5173 8001 && py backend/generate_ssl.py --host localhost --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.preprod: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/free-ports.ps1 4173 8001 && py backend/generate_ssl.py --host localhost --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.prod: npm run build && concurrently -k "py -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --ssl-keyfile backend/.local/key.pem --ssl-certfile backend/.local/cert.pem" "vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173"
